metadata.boundary: Exclusive disposable non-production runtime surface for T003 cutover-readiness rehearsal. T003 consumes only the separately leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source produced by T007; it does not materialize source from, read, or require authority over /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git or the mutable Heim-PC checkout. Reconstruction and boot consume the artifact manifest-bound Git commit/tree, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. The sandbox may expose a blank virtual block device and disposable restore scratch only after fresh evidence proves its backing is not the productive Heim-PC root/system disk, any mounted production filesystem, or production EFI/firmware state. Independent off-host backup material may be consumed read-only for restore testing but grants no production-device write authority.
does_not_establish: production EFI or firmware mutation authority
production NixOS install or activation authority
